title: Not Today Void
description: Prevents the void from killing the player.
body:
Not Today Void is a Minecraft plugin that disables void damage to the player. Now you can fall into the void forever... No more accidental deaths from falling off the edge of the world or miscalculated parkour jumps!

**Key Features**:
- Complete void damage prevention - Players can fall into the void indefinitely without taking damage or dying
- Zero configuration required - Install and forget; works immediately upon server startup
- Minimal performance impact - Optimized event handling ensures no server lag or TPS drops
